title: The Right Decision Often Feels Wrong
coreMove: Guilt and grief after an honest, necessary choice are healthy waves, not proof you got it wrong, so let them crest and fall while the decision stays.

exampleSpecs.domain: Source case: Podcast listener dreading a wedding
exampleSpecs.audience: Sonia and readers facing emotional wave
exampleSpecs.stakes: A clear decision can feel unbearable when the emotional fallout is vivid.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Show Sonia using emotional wave in the source case without controlling another person.
